purpose: Record completed candidate hard-gate outcomes after streaming generation still exceeded 1200 seconds.

execution.telemetry: One flushed record after each completed existing GateRegistry.run call.

noninterference_boundary: The wrapper delegates unchanged gate context to the original GateRegistry.run, records only the returned report, and returns that same object. It cannot qualify S07 or establish exact timing.
failure_policy: Terminate at 360 seconds, preserve completed gate records, zero retry.
authorization_basis: Codex approved this bounded development-only diagnostic after v4 proved that ordered streaming alone did not complete within the unchanged runtime budget.
